headline: Shopify now recovers carts on WhatsApp
changed: Shopify Messaging now has WhatsApp automations for abandoned browse, cart and checkout. Pre-built templates, inside your Shopify admin, on Basic plan and above.
means: India rate is $0.024 per message, about ₹2, added to your Shopify bill. Only shoppers who opted in to WhatsApp marketing get it, so collect consent first.
action: Connect WhatsApp, then turn on the abandoned checkout template under Messaging > Automations.
